correctness.rationale: The cyclic subspace has one bright direction P_E v per distinct eigenvalue with nonzero sink projection. Its orthogonal complement reduces both the adjacency and the dissipative generator; on the bright block there is no eigenvector of zero loss, hence that finite block decays. Ring eigenvalues are strictly decreasing on the chosen half range and every ring spectral weight at 0 is m_k/n. I checked the collision lemma: the Ramanujan trace and squared trace give φ(m)+c_m(2)≤2μ(m). Odd m>1 is impossible; if 4 divides m, all nonnegative conjugates sum to zero and m=4. For m=2q with q odd, φ(q)≤−3μ(q) forces q=3 (q=1 fails, and φ(q)≥4 for odd q≥5). m=1 gives 2. Applying the lemma to a_j and −a_k gives exactly the three listed pairs and three distinct collision energies. At a collision, the v,w projections have squared norms (q+q′)/2 and inner product (q−q′)/2, with the signs from the two transverse sectors; their dark component has weight 2qq′/(q+q′). The noncollision terms are zero. Applying the exact endpoint/interior ring multiplicities gives 4/(3n) twice for 4|n and 2/n once for 6|n, and the bright rank follows by counting distinct levels. The dark dimension is positive even at n=3, and the mixed-state absorption is the normalized bright trace. Independent exact cyclotomic and rational Krylov replays verify finite instances, including S(w)=7/18 at n=12.
residual_risks: The analytic proof, not the finite replay, covers all sizes. Requires a loss rate strictly greater than zero and the exact unweighted cyclic prism.

evidence: Starting from two branches of floor(n/2)+1 distinct levels each, the exact earlier list subtracts 2·1_(4|n)+1_(6|n) repeats. At v and w each Fourier mode has squared weight 1/(2n) and its crossed weight is ±1/(2n) by layer sign. Thus a collision of sector counts m,m′ has dark contribution [(m+m′)−(m−m′)²/(m+m′)]/(2n). The published index counts are (1,2),(2,1),(2,2) for precisely the three relevant collisions; off collisions all signs agree.

value.rationale: The prism and opposite-rung capture are natural, and the correct formulas can be useful illustrations. However, the exact arithmetic information is already known for the same graph. Bright rank is a count of the listed levels, and survival is one routine two-sector projection with the already indexed mode multiplicities. There is no independently resolved obstruction or newly established threshold beyond those mechanically implied by the prior data, nor a surviving separately motivated result in the frozen claim that meets the value standard.
residual_risks: Does not dismiss the value of a different sink-placement classification, a new finite-time law, or other claims not established here.
